rationale: The assistant gave the right immediate actions: keep the door shut, switch off, no water, and escalate if the fire spreads. It also advised stop-use and reporting to the landlord, with photos and written notice. Weaknesses: it told a UK user to call 911 rather than 999, suggested a breaker or 'Stop' button as options, and said 'danger has mostly passed' while smoke was still inside. It also suggested microwaving lemon water in the damaged unit, and its advice to open the door and bin the bag was reasonable only after cooling.
